title: hushrun.guide/v1
description: Output of `hushrun guide --format json` (spec C-28, ADR 0065): what a coding agent needs to know about this hushrun beyond its skill, and what is true here: a newer release the notice learned of, build reuse's mode and store, and each copy of the skill. It asks nobody, changes nothing, and exits 0. Fields are only ever added.

skillRevision.description: This hushrun's revision of the skill, which its SKILL.md says as metadata.hushrun-skill (C-24).

guide.description: The guide, in Markdown: what this hushrun's lines mean, how to set it up, and how it and its skill are kept current.

update.description: A newer release than this hushrun, as the newer-release notice last learned of it (C-21), with no question asked now; null when none is known, or with HUSHRUN_NO_UPDATE_CHECK set.

command.description: What updates this hushrun: `hushrun update`, or the package manager's install where one installed it, such as `npm install hushrun@latest`.

build.description: Build reuse on this machine, as `hushrun build status` reads it (B-21): the mode a `hushrun run` from this shell takes on a person's machine, and the store. Null when there is no configuration directory to keep build settings in. An older hushrun leaves it out.

mode.description: off, observe or on, HUSHRUN_BUILD applied; null when the settings file can't be read, which turns reuse off.

savedMode.description: The mode the settings file names, when HUSHRUN_BUILD sets another in this shell; else null.

error.description: Why the settings file can't be read; else null.

settings.description: The person's build settings file, build.json beside hushrun's credentials.

store.description: The store's folder; null when HUSHRUN_CACHE_DIR is empty, so nothing is kept.

blocks.description: How many blocks the store holds; null with no store.

bytes.description: Their files' apparent size; a file cloned into a target folder is counted here too. Null with no store.

inCi.description: Whether this is CI, where `hushrun run` reads no person's settings.

skills.description: Each copy of the skill hushrun looks at: the repository's, when it runs in one, then the person's own, under ~.

path.description: Relative to the repository's root, or ~/… for the person's own.

state.description: current: this hushrun's revision. older: an older hushrun wrote it, and `hushrun skill update` updates it. newer: a newer hushrun wrote it, and this hushrun is the one to update. edited: no hushrun wrote this text, and hushrun leaves it. absent: there is none.

revision.description: The revision it says, for current, older and newer: 0 for a text a hushrun wrote before revisions.
